subject.title: feat: add Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept this Computer Use manifest contract through the original dirty branch, the rebased successor PR, or pause the public API until host-binding semantics are settled?
rationale: The change is additive, but it publishes plugin API surface that future host code may use around Accessibility and Screen Recording permission discovery, so automation should not choose the API/security boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Use the rebased successor path
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 as the likely canonical branch, keep this PR as source credit/context until a maintainer closes or supersedes it, and require docs plus discovery-only semantics before merge.

options.title: Revive this branch
options.body: Ask the author to rebase this PR, regenerate docs, and continue review here if maintainers want the original branch to remain the landing candidate.

options.title: Pause the contract
options.body: Keep both drafts blocked or close them manually if the macOS Computer Use host model is not ready for public plugin manifest fields.

recommendation.title: Use the rebased successor path
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101564 as the likely canonical branch, keep this PR as source credit/context until a maintainer closes or supersedes it, and require docs plus discovery-only semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on this manifest/docs surface and owns the open rebased successor branch.
